facts.name: recipe in a box called cookie-recipe
facts.html:
Chocolate chip cookies

The classic, crisp at the edge and soft in the middle, ready in 30 minutes.

Ingredients

  • 225 g butter
  • 200 g sugar
  • 2 eggs
  • 300 g flour
  • 200 g chocolate chips

Method

  1. Cream butter and sugar.
  2. Beat in the eggs.
  3. Fold in flour and chips.
  4. Bake at 180 C for 11 minutes.

Store them in a tin for up to five days. They also freeze well for a month in a sealed bag.

More notes on butter temperature, chilling the dough, and why brown sugar makes them chewier: the longer the dough rests in the fridge, the deeper the flavour gets, up to 72 hours.

facts.name: docs warning in an aside inside main (Starlight)
facts.html:
Delete a project

Use the CLI to remove a project and everything in it from your account.

Caution

This cannot be undone: all deployments, domains and environment variables are deleted at once.

acme project rm my-project --yes

The command asks for confirmation unless you pass --yes. It needs owner rights on the team, and it prints the id of every deleted deployment.

facts.name: docs section about localization
facts.html:
Translations

How the framework finds the right language for each visitor, and how you add one.

Add a language

Create a file locales/de.json with your strings and add "de" to the locales list in config.json; the router picks it up on the next build.

Fallbacks: a missing string falls back to the default locale, which is English unless you set defaultLocale. Dates and numbers use the Intl API of the runtime.

facts.html:
Benefits

An overview of the benefits you can claim, and where to apply for each of them online or by post.

Social security

You can claim from age 67. Apply three months before you want the payments to start, online or at a local office.

Other benefits: housing benefit, child benefit and unemployment benefit, each with its own rules and forms described on their own pages.
